visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor home setting. A young girl with her hair in small buns and wearing a striped colorful top sits at a wooden dining table. A hand belonging to an adult (mother) enters the frame holding two tubes of cream glue—one red and one white. A pink hair clip base lies on the table. (2) The camera focuses on a large assortment of colorful miniature charms spread across the table, including shapes like donuts, Hello Kitty, stars, and flowers. The mother's hand with gold rings moves through the charms. (3) The girl is seen holding a red tube of cream glue, carefully squeezing it onto a pink hair clip base. Her face shows deep concentration, eyes focused on her hands. The background shows a light-colored room with wooden furniture and a pet house. (4) The mother holds up a finished blue hair clip decorated with a donkey charm and white flowers. The girl continues to work in the background, choosing from the various charms. (5) The girl is now squeezing a yellow cream glue tube. She looks up and smiles briefly. The scene cuts to her placing small charms onto the yellow glue on a hair clip. (6) A montage shows several finished hair clips with themes like Donald Duck, 'Luck' text, and various sweets. (7) The mother is shown holding a hair clip and placing it onto the hair of a toddler wearing a red shirt who is sitting in a high chair. The toddler looks curious. (8) The final visual phase shows the older girl wearing the clips she made while working on a workbook at the table. A yellow graphic screen appears at the end with an animation of two children and the text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming begins with a bright piano melody. A cheerful adult female voice greets and introduces the activity with a high pitch and rising intonation. (2) A wet, squelching sound effect accompanies the visual of cream glue being squeezed. The mother's voice continues warmly. (3) The older girl's high-pitched voice is heard, speaking clearly and expressing excitement. (4) A 'ding' sound effect plays as a charm is successfully placed. The BGM remains consistent and energetic. (5) Light laughter from the mother and the sound of charms clinking together are audible. (6) The toddler's soft babbling and a 'pop' sound effect are heard as the mother interacts with her. The mother's tone shifts to a very gentle, nurturing cadence. (7) The video concludes with a short, bright melodic jingle (stinger SFX) as the brand logo appears, with the acoustic music fading out.
